main_text.p: Hæ Vuan-dalorum nomine fa.sò[?] iusig-nia[?].Cæterum qui Vinulos[?], eu[?] Vendos, reli-quámve Sclavorum gentem Vandalorum nomine honestare contenduūt, plane fal-luntur. Constat enim classicorum scriptorum auctoritate, Vandalos ex Gotthorum ortos esse gente: quemadmodum & Sciros, Gepidas, Alanos, ac reliquos Gotthicæ nationis populos: inter quos nihil præter solam interfuit nomenclaturam, ejsdem enim institutis eademque utebantur lingua, Germanica nempe: quemadmodum (ut dictum est) ex reliquiis quoq; Gotthorū, qui montana Tauricæ Chersonnesi præsenti ætate obtinent, discedere licet: quum Sclavorum, Vendorum & Viltzorum loquela penitus à Germanica sit diversa. Quin & diu entea[?] quàm Sclavorum nomen est auditum, Vandali populariter cum liberis & uxoribus è patria emigrárant[?], jamque Lusitaniæ partem tenebant, ac in Africam traijcientes, Carthaginem cum universa illa provincia suo subjecerant imperio. Sed & tam Ostrogothi quàm Visigothi Christianam tum suscepérant[?] fidem, quum Sclavi sub initium omnis religionis fuerint expertes: quorum tanquam novorum hostiū nomen, sub Mauritio primùm auditum est: excursionesque eorum à Justiniano non parùm sunt repressæ, donec immensa multitudine superantes magnam

page.notes: Marginal note at left: the italic text is set in a heavier, slanted face and is partly damaged; "falsò" and "iusig-nia" are doubtful. Running head "DE LINGVIS" is at the top of the page. No page number is printed. The catchword "magnam" is at the lower right. "entea" appears to be printed as shown and may be a printing error for "antea". "eu" and "Vinulos" are uncertain readings. The text ends with "superantes" as the last full line, the catchword is not repeated in the text. The paragraph is continuous and has no indent breaks.
